ov: بركات (الإنجليزية: !Barakat) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الجزائر وفرنسا وصدر في سنة 2006 وهو من إخراج جميلة الصحراوي
plotEn: During the Algerian Civil War, Amel (Rachida Brakni) is a doctor who, on returning home from work one day, discovers that her journalist husband has gone missing. Receiving no help from the authorities, she decides to look for him herself. She is helped by another woman, Khadidja.
